body:
Some of this was written during the experience, and some was written the next day. A lot of the messages are things that I said to my friends at the time that I felt were prudent to include. Time is measured in time since ingestion
Preparation: I took ~3g of Piracetam every morning and night for 5 days beforehand. An hour before taking any drugs, I took 2g of Piracetam. I should have also taken 240mg of Magnesium and 600mg of Alpha-Lipoic Acid (ALP) an hour before, but I ended up taking them only a few minutes before. I also continued to take 600mg of ALP roughly every hour for the next ~6 hours
(I've been told that Piracetam is supposed to reduce damage from MDMA and make it feel better. As a side effect, it's also supposed to improve language comprehension. I've also been told that it should also be paired with Tianeptine, but I couldn't find a good place to get that, and I was told it's not super neccessary; apparently, Piracetam is more for protecting your brain, and Tianeptine is more for making the drug feel better)
0:00 I take 125mg of MDMA
0:13 I take 30mg of 4-HO-MET. Mixing powerful hallucinogens like this is very dangerous, as they have unpredictable synergies, and I am likely edging psychosis by doing this
0:42 I take 60mg of MDMA (I've heard you're supposed to dose twice like this for a smoother ride and less damage)
0:45 Wow everything is sooo soft holy fuckkk
I am literally just rubbing my legs together and its the best feeling I've ever felt holty fuckkkk
I normally can't stand being touched at all, but every single feeling is just perfect right now no matter what it is
0:50 Turns out drugs feel great
Do people know about this
1:15 Everything feels perfect
I am like so chill about Everything
Around this point I took 2g more of Piracetam. I normally have a very hard time swallowing, but even swallowing pills feels absolutely incredible on my throat
1:34 Literally no matter what I do everything feels perfect
I'm soupppp
1:39 I seem to have a pretty good grasp on my words though, which may be due to the piracetam
I'm experiencing all the same feelings as normal but in a fundamentally different way from normal
Like, things are funny, and that feels good, but its not the same as the funny when I'm sober
I have to drink a lot of water, which is annoying since I really just want to spend all of my time nonstop telling my friends how much I love them, but staying hydrated is important. It's also very hard to eat, but I have to eat at least a bit
I'm probably sitting in an uncomfortable position that would normally hurt my back, but because everything feels perfect, I can't even tell
1:41 it just feels like everything is okay and its always gonna be okay
1:49 I inhaled about 5g of Nitrous Oxide. I've heard this sensation described as "blasting off", which is probably the only way I could possibly describe it. It genuinely felt like my brain was a rocket ship flying into space. But, as soon as I started feeling it, it was over, which was so lame that I decided I honestly don't even really care. It just seems so empty and hollow compared to the intense existential contentment and love I get from MDMA, so it meant nothing to me
1:52 Ohhh my goddd how did I only just now realize how wonderful perfect my life isss and how much I care about everyone in it yess that means youyyy
2:52 Thannnkk you all so much for beibg my friends even when I'm kinda weird and I'm sure when I'm sober ill feel a bit anxious abt having said all this but its all true and you care and I can finally see that
Around this point I took 2g more of Piracetam
3:02 Oh my god the degree to which you matter to me is like wayyyy more than I realized
3:17 Omg I bet ill be like so embarrassed and ashamed that I dumped out my feelings like this later and itlll suckkkk lol
3:26 I am insanely lucky to have ended up where I am with so many friends that care about me and are also genuinely kind
And I couldn't see it bc I was scared to talk to any of them
3:30 I finally realized that people can actually care about me
3:54 I always knew you cared about me but I didnt like
Fully realize that so I was operating under the assumption that I was super annoying at best
And wow that explains so mucb
I've always viewed every interaction I have with anyone as them hating me and me desperately trying to make them stop hating me and wow I clearly have some sort of serious attachment disorder
I really shouldn't see talking to someone as nothing but a way to gain approval and hide my true level of care for them
3:57 Ohhh my god I cant see when people care??? Is that why it doesnt feel right when youre all nice to me
I mean I knew that but I didnt like. Well feel it like I said before
4:05 Turns out mdma makes you instantly process all of your unresolved feelings and mental illness and grasp that you are loved and that you have done wrong but have changed
4:19 It feels like all my senses are in a different language
I still understand them, but its like...encoded in a different format
4:24 Ohhh my god this is so amazing in every way its too bad that this is like nuclearly terrible for your brain and super unsace lolll
4:30 Ohhh my god I just realized that merit and good traits and stuff I look up to are things I can have, not just reserved for others
Totally did not feel the impact of that until just now
4:40 I think I just resolved the weird and concerning standoffish state I left my last relationship in by realizing how and why it went how it did and that ppl can change
5:05 I think I finally grasped the difference between drugs that make you feel good in a good way & ones that make you feel good in an evil, hollow way
Theyre all really dangerous but some are just a vice and some are that but can also genuinely help u in some ways if ur rly careful
Evil feeling good is where you just get flooded with happy but everything still sucks
Good feeling good is where you think differently in a way that is happier
Literally "look on the bright side" but fr
5:55 I start to feel pretty bad and weak
I think I just unleashed every feeling I have ever had all at once and completely ran out of feelings
Now I get to experience the part of this that explains why more people dont do this!!! Exciting!!!
I am sooo curious how well I will handle this but I think ill be okay
6:15 I think moving a single muscle would be an effort impressive to heracles but I'm weirdly enthusiastic about this. Like fuck yeah I can 1v1 this shit put me in coach
Might be a little psychosis talking which I did know I would probably get but I think its mostly the good kind of psychosis
Psychosis? More like finally having self-confidence right
Everyone knows I totally win this mu every time
6:25 I feel okay again. Presumably, I just went through the MDMA comedown, and am probably just on 4-HO-MET right now (though it's hard to say exactly what's happening when mixing hallucinogens, since they do weird things to each other)
6:30 Holy shit I was looking at the wall in the bathroom and it looked like it was flashing super rapidly with impossibly complex patterns and my eyes hurt as if the flashing light was real
And then I saw a bunch of colorful letters in unreadable gibberish on a computer screen
I've never like full on hallicinated before this should be fun
6:48 I might have been watching too much of the show archer bc in the movie I'm watching someone said george and I'm pretty sure I heard and saw archer
6:55 I felt more today than I have felt over the last 20+ years combined
7:00 I am having vivid archer-based hallucinations
Everything is characters from archer???
Goofy ass hallucinations
I watched multiple movies and shows and at multiple points was genuinely uncertain if each of them was actually Archer because I was seeing and hearing all of the characters from archer
7:07 No amount of words could ever even remotely prepare anyone for how that felt. It is too alien to comprehend. Which is what literally everyone always says. Because duh
7:14 I thibk everyone that wants to do this frequently is completely missing the point and a little crazy..the best part is what I learned abt myself not the drug itself
7:36 I think I might finally be convinced that I actually exist and am real and know what feelings r bc before today I was really uncertain about that
~20:00 I wake up the next morning. I feel pretty fuzzy and like the world is made of love, and I don't feel bad at all. I can still feel love
I never really understood why MDMA is so ubiquitous despite its danger. So many drugs that are way less bad for you are treated as if they're so much more dangerous, but I think I get why now. MDMA is still insanely dangerous, but it feels like it doesn't want to hurt you. It can and almost certainly will, but if you work with it, everything feels like it's going to be perfect forever no matter what happens. Compared to eg. Opioids, which make you insanely happy but feel like the happiness is fighting against and overwhelming you in a really uncomfortable way, like the sheer euphoria is a cascade of knives
I felt every good feeling I've ever had over the entirety of my life erupt from me all at once a million times over per millisecond and then finally realized that I am real and I am loved and finally realized that I love my friends too and that I matter and I feel like I cured my mental illnesses
And I still feel so nice in such a natural way, like everything is gonna be okay no matter what
I'm finding myself very able to forgive myself and others for mistakes without basking in self hate or pointless grudges, when I previously couldn't
I'm also feeling as though my understanding of language is somewhat improved, so it seems like Piracetam probably does actually work, at least for that
~48:00 I still feel good, but I also feel such a sense of existential contentment that I don't really have much of a desire to do anything
~72:00 I'm feeling mostly normal, but a bit fuzzy and a bit less mentally ill, still more capable of love and being loved, which I imagine will probably stick
I noticed that the uncontrollable fear response I used to get when touched is now almost entirely gone
I still feel greatly heightened emotional maturity and understanding too. It just feels like it's so much easier for me to understand what I'm feeling, what others are feeling, and what I should be saying
If anything I'm honestly a little bit in shock because this feels really weird and I'm not sure what to make of it. I mean, I guess it's a good thing, but it's so weird. I wonder if this is what a normal person is supposed to be like
Conclusion
After the third day of feeling a bit odd, I think I'm finally back to normal. But I still carry with me the lessons I learned, and I feel far more able to cope with my various mental problems and my relationships now
